nodes.text: Open your own Draenor Engineering recipes and select Secrets of Draenor Engineering.

recovery.text: If the recipe is missing, switch expansion tiers and clear recipe filters. Skill level alone does not prove the recipe is learned.

recoveryCases.text: If the recipe is missing, switch expansion tiers and clear recipe filters. Skill level alone does not prove the recipe is learned.
Open your own Draenor Engineering recipes and select Secrets of Draenor Engineering.

nodes.text: Craft Secrets of Draenor Engineering when its observed cooldown is ready. Gather the listed materials and tools first; use the in-game Craft button yourself.
nodes.details:
Open your own Draenor Engineering recipes.
Craft Secrets of Draenor Engineering when available. Materials: 5 True Iron Ore. Tools: none listed.
